title: Thinking Before Retrieving: Robust Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval via Strategic Planning and Self-Criticism
abstract: arXiv:2606.31222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Composed image retrieval requires identifying a target image from a gallery by integrating a reference image with a textual modification instruction. In a training-free zero-shot setting, this task relies on constructing a retrieval-oriented textual query within a frozen vision--language embedding space at inference time. Existing approaches predominantly rely on a single-pass generation strategy that fuses the reference context and modification text into a unified description. This strategy makes it difficult to detect or correct semantic distortions and omissions during generation. Consequently, the preservation of reference attributes and the integration of textual requirements interfere with each other, which degrades retrieval precision. To address these challenges, we introduce PEC-CIR, a training-free framework that structures query construction as a multi-stage reasoning pipeline. The framework operates through a Planner--Exe

translated_title: 检索前思考：通过策略规划与自我批判实现鲁棒的零样本组合图像检索
translated_abstract: 组合图像检索要求通过将参考图像与文本修改指令相结合，从图库中识别目标图像。在无需训练、零样本的设置下，该任务依赖于在推理时于冻结的视觉-语言嵌入空间中构建面向检索的文本查询。现有方法主要依赖单次生成策略，将参考上下文和修改文本融合成统一描述。这种策略难以在生成过程中检测或纠正语义扭曲和遗漏。因此，参考属性的保留和文本要求的整合相互干扰，导致检索精度下降。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了PEC-CIR，一个无需训练的框架，将查询构建结构化为多阶段推理流程。该框架通过规划者-执行者机制运作。
tldr: 本文提出PEC-CIR框架，通过多阶段推理和自批判机制，在零样本组合图像检索中有效分离参考属性保留与文本指令整合，提升检索精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PEC-CIR, a training-free framework that uses multi-stage reasoning and self-criticism to decouple reference attribute preservation from textual instruction integration, improving retrieval accuracy in zero-shot composed image retrieval.
